name: Rice (lowland)
pest_notes: Blast, stem borer, brown planthopper; needs standing water
plain_description: The staple food crop. Grows best on flat land that holds water.

name: Salt-tolerant rice
pest_notes: Same pests as rice; yield drops as salt rises
plain_description: Rice varieties bred to survive salty water in coastal deltas.

name: Maize
pest_notes: Fall armyworm, stem borer; heavy nitrogen user
plain_description: A tall cereal for grain and animal feed. Needs steady water and fertiliser.

name: Soybean
pest_notes: Rust, pod borers, bean fly
plain_description: A protein crop that adds nitrogen to the soil for the next crop.

name: Groundnut (peanut)
pest_notes: Leaf spot, aflatoxin in storage, needs phosphorus
plain_description: An oil and food legume that suits sandy soil and fixes nitrogen.

name: Green gram (mung bean)
pest_notes: Pod borer, yellow mosaic virus; spoils if harvest rains
plain_description: A very short pulse that fits between main crops and fixes nitrogen.

name: Black gram
pest_notes: Yellow mosaic virus, pod borer
plain_description: A short pulse grown after rice on leftover soil moisture.

name: Cowpea
pest_notes: Aphids, pod borers
plain_description: A hardy bean for poor, sandy, hot fields. Also good as animal feed or green manure.

name: Pigeon pea
pest_notes: Pod borer, wilt; slow early growth
plain_description: A deep-rooted pulse that survives drought and can shelter other crops from wind.

name: Chickpea
pest_notes: Pod borer, wilt; fails if soil dries too early
plain_description: A cool-season pulse grown on moisture left after the monsoon.

name: Sesame
pest_notes: Leaf spot, webworm; hates waterlogging
plain_description: A heat-loving oil crop with a strong market. Little soil cover.

name: Sunflower
pest_notes: Birds, downy mildew, head rot in rain
plain_description: An oil crop with deep roots that tolerates heat and dry spells.

name: Sorghum
pest_notes: Shoot fly, birds, grain mould in rain
plain_description: A drought-tough cereal. Breaks disease cycles in legume-heavy fields.

name: Cassava
pest_notes: Mosaic disease, mealybug; drains soil nutrients
plain_description: A starchy root that tolerates drought and sandy soil but exhausts the soil.

name: Sugarcane
pest_notes: Borers, smut; needs mill within haul distance
plain_description: A long-season cash crop that needs a nearby sugar mill.

name: Potato
pest_notes: Late blight, bacterial wilt
plain_description: A cool-weather tuber. Only suits highlands or the cool dry season.

name: Watermelon
pest_notes: Fusarium wilt, aphids, fruit fly
plain_description: A quick dry-season fruit on sandy beds with irrigation.

name: Mixed vegetables
pest_notes: Many pests; needs steady water
plain_description: Short-cycle vegetables for local markets near towns.

name: Cashew
pest_notes: Tea mosquito bug, anthracnose
plain_description: A drought-tolerant tree crop. Not a rotation crop, but fits dry upland.

name: Sunn hemp (green manure)
pest_notes: Few pests; seed supply can be hard
plain_description: A fast legume grown to be ploughed in, to rebuild poor sandy soil.

name: Legume cover crop (e.g. Pueraria)
pest_notes: Can smother young trees if unmanaged
plain_description: A ground-cover legume between young tree crops. Fixes nitrogen and stops erosion.
